title: claude-pr-automerge must re-check the PR's CURRENT head before arming (a hold declared after a queued run can be armed over)
note: [2026-10-14 weekly planning] OPERATOR-APPROVED 2026-10-14. Source: PI-20261007-CJT6J2S9-0001 -- MEASURED on PR #16984: run 37671365711 queued on head 6efa01a3 (landing: self) at 19:01:47Z, executed 19:49:10Z, and armed native auto-merge although the head had become ef82483b with landing: hold and no request file. Build: the request gate and the E63 landing gate read the PR's head at execution time (pull_request_read), refuse when the request file or the self declaration is gone from that head, and log the queued-vs-current sha pair. Test with the #16984 shape. Related cluster: AUTOMERGE-GAPS. [2026-10-14 ~07:50Z manager addition, MEASURED 2026-10-14] SECOND FAILURE IN SCOPE -- a CONFLICTED stamp PR is never refreshed and nothing names it: dispatcher stamp PR #18004 (automation/research-queue-stamp-38519778952-1, created 06:23Z) conflicted with #17995 (merged 06:21Z; both edited research/queue/RQ-20261014-65cc-{01,06,09,10}.yaml), ran 0 checks and sat unmergeable ~80 min. Effect: 6 units ran at 06:02Z but their dispatch stamp never landed; the dispatcher withheld them as having an open stamp while they read as runnable; the watchdog escalated a false 'github_runner_data idle 100 min' (#17895 comment 6163466113, 07:39Z) and its self-heal dispatch could not help. Root cause: a conflicting stamp PR is neither refreshed nor re-cut, and the watchdog's stranded-stamp check is time-based only. Fix scope (added to this row): (1) the dispatcher re-cuts, or merges main into, a conflicted stamp PR on its next cycle; (2) the watchdog reports 'stamp PR #N conflicting' directly instead of an idle alarm. Hand-fixed this time by the manager: main merged into the stamp branch (commit 26ec467b, stamp + grading.auto kept), merging. [lane 2026-10-14] PR #18065 (landing: hold, R12). A already had a head-moved guard (2026-10-09); added current-head re-read + sha-pair log. B: sweeper resolves regenerable stamp/receipt conflicts, watchdog check_conflicted_automation. landed_unproven until the first conflicted stamp PR is auto-resolved/named. [2026-10-14T18:09Z manager session_01VduHYzdaXe27wTDBLSu8ao] Dispatched: Sonnet (build lane, no order path), fresh (spec is on the row), ceiling $12. [2026-10-14 manager] Scope widened per handover: also conflicted automation stamp/receipt PRs (#18004, #18014 fixed by hand) -- re-cut or merge main, and the watchdog names them.

observation.what: (a) claude-pr-automerge reads the PR head at execution time and refuses to arm when that head carries landing: hold or no request file; a replay of the #16984 shape is refused and logged with the queued-vs-current sha pair. (b) a conflicted dispatcher stamp PR is re-cut or refreshed by the dispatcher on its next cycle and the research watchdog names it (stamp PR #N conflicting) instead of raising an idle alarm; verified on the first stamp conflict after the fix lands, or by a test that plants a conflicting stamp branch
observation.how_to_check: the workflow run log of the first PR where the head moved between queue and execution, plus the test added for the gate; for (b) the dispatcher log line + watchdog report on the next stamp conflict, and the tests for both
